package pagination

import foundryhttp "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"

type PageEndpoint struct{}
type AuthenticatedPage[M any] struct{}

func Authenticated[M any](PageEndpoint, foundryhttp.GuardBinding[M], foundryhttp.AccessRule[M], ...foundryhttp.ActorOption[M]) AuthenticatedPage[M] {
	return AuthenticatedPage[M]{}
}
func ConfigureAuthenticated[M any](e AuthenticatedPage[M], _ ...foundryhttp.ActorOption[M]) AuthenticatedPage[M] {
	return e
}
